gloss: feeling of futility; sense of wasted effort

definitions.gloss: feeling of futility; sense of wasted effort
definitions.explanation: The emotional sense that one's efforts were pointless or produced no meaningful result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{徒労感|とろうかん}しか⟦{残|のこ}らない→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter what I do, all that remains is a feeling of futility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧ず、⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{徒労感|とろうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I worked long hours but got no results, and was struck by a strong sense of futility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わら→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧ず、{徒労感|とろうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I explained, the other person didn't understand, and I felt a sense of wasted effort.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{徒労|とろう}→徒労：15513_torou⟧ (futile effort, wasted labor) and ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). Expresses the emotional weight of having put in effort that came to nothing — heavier and more literary than simply saying ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧だった (it was pointless).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徒労感|とろうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel a sense of futility
- {徒労感|とろうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be struck by a sense of futility
- {徒労感|とろうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: a feeling of futility remains
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{徒労感|とろうかん}: deep sense of futility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {虚|むな}しさ: emptiness; a broader feeling of meaninglessness
- ⟦{徒労|とろう}→徒労：15513_torou⟧: wasted effort (the objective fact, without the emotional component)
- ⟦{脱力感|だつりょくかん}→脱力感：16094_datsuryokukan⟧: feeling of exhaustion/lethargy — physical rather than emotional
